scope: i18n of Crash, Coinflip, Rewards, Stake (9 locales: en de pt fr it es tr zh ko)
level: unit + local runtime (next dev :3034, Chromium 1194). Not production build, not hosted, not CI, no native-speaker review.
commands: PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER=true PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3034 PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome bash scripts/use-node.sh pnpm --filter @sollish/web test:browser <spec> --workers=1 --output=<scratch>

browser_tr_forced.lobby: 15/15 (one 430px test failed once on a cold first run, passed on rerun)

results.note: the first product run had 3 failures from cold dev compile timeouts; the rerun passed 14/14

turkish_identity: every tr string fragment of crash/coinflip/incentives/common additions was matched against the original source text; only 'Geçersiz dönem' (from lib/tokens.ts default) is new text, identical to that default

locale_scan.method: for 8 non-tr locales, /game/crash, /game/coinflip, /rewards, /stake: body innerText scanned for Turkish letters and for leaked message keys
locale_scan.turkish_letters: only locale names (Turkce, Francais) in the language selector; de/pt legitimately use u/o/c with diacritics
